reference.title: Scenario 11 — Image with floating text boxes layered on top
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document where an image is inserted into the document body and multiple text

section.p: Consider a document where an image is inserted into the document body and multiple text boxes are manually positioned on top of the image to create labels, admonitions, or annotations. The text boxes use floating layouts such as Square, Tight, Behind Text, or In Front of Text.

row.entry: [Inline image]: network_topology.png [Floating text box]: Database Server [Floating text box]: Application Server [Floating text box]: Load Balancer

section.p: Result:The converter extracts and preserves the image itself because it exists as a valid document image object. However, floating text boxes layered above the image are ignored during conversion.
section.note: For annotated diagrams, embed labels directly into the image before inserting it into Word.
